raw_text: Punjab Farmer Union update: Tractor convoys assembling at Shambhu, Khanauri, and Jind border points. Over 5,000 tractors confirmed for tomorrow's march. Barricade bypass routes mapped and shared in coordination groups. Medical teams stationed every 10 km along the route. We will reach Delhi peacefully but firmly.
